articles.headline: Terrence Shannon Jr. scores career-high 34 points as Timberwolves beat Trail Blazers 106-98
articles.description: — Terrence Shannon Jr. scored 12 of his career-high 34 points in the second quarter as the Minnesota Timberwolves recovered from a slow start to beat the Portland Trail Blazers 106-98 on Monday night in the opener of a two-game set.

articles.headline: Fears' first triple-double leads the Pelicans past the Warriors 115-94
articles.description: — Jeremiah Fears had 19 points, 10 assists and 10 rebounds for his first career triple-double, and the New Orleans Pelicans snapped a six-game losing streak with a 115-94 victory over the Golden State Warriors on Monday night.
